## Scope check

This package is deliberately small: albums rather than tracks, one hand-edited
source, a short list rather than a full history. Requests that fit that shape
land much faster than ones that widen it.

- [ ] This keeps the album as the unit
- [ ] This does not require a music user token or any `/v1/me/` endpoint
